'''''Gloomwood''''' is an <!-- Per [[Wikipedia:Manual of Style/Video games]], early access games are considered upcoming -->upcoming first-person [[Stealth game|stealth]] [[survival horror]] [[video game]] developed by Dillon Rogers and [[David Szymanski]] and published by [[New Blood Interactive]]. The player controls an unnamed doctor who makes his way through the [[Victorian era|Victorian]] style titular city. The game features stealth and exploratory gameplay, along with utilizing weapons (melee and firearms) against enemies.

The game is heavily inspired by the [[Thief (series)|''Thief'' series of games]], especially its first two: ''[[Thief: The Dark Project|The Dark Project]]'' (1998) and ''[[Thief II|The Metal Age]]'' (2000).<ref name="Destructoid-6-13-20">{{cite web|url=https://www.destructoid.com/gloomwoods-stealth-n-slash-action-invokes-90s-classic-thief/|title=''Gloomwood''{{'s}} stealth 'n' slash action invokes '90s classic ''Thief''|last=Moyse|first=Chris|date=June 13, 2020|work=[[Destructoid]]|access-date=July 8, 2023}}</ref> It has also been favorably compared to ''[[Dishonored (series)|Dishonored]]'',<ref name="SR-9-9-22">{{cite web|url=https://screenrant.com/gloomwood-early-access-survival-horror-dishonored-immersive-gameplay/|title=''Gloomwood'' Turns ''Dishonored'' Into A Survival Horror Nightmare|last=Tate|first=Alexander|date=September 9, 2022|work=[[Screen Rant]]|access-date=July 8, 2023}}</ref> ''[[Bloodborne]]'',<ref name="NME-9-6-22">{{cite Having been announced in June 2020, ''Gloomwood'' was released via [[early access]] on September 5, 2022, after a delay from its initial August 16, 2022 date. The pre-release builds have received praise for the atmosphere, tone, world, level design and gameplay, but has been criticized for the unfinished elements and difficulty.{{Citation needed|date=November 2025|reason=The game has received several updates, one releasing before the end of 2025 according to the developers, leading to it being beneficial for a discussion around whether or not general sources still have this view/rating of the game. Whether or not it is true, it would be a good idea to back up this claim with primary or secondary sources. By a glance of the title at the first citation on this article, there do seem to be sources that fit this claim.}}

==Gameplay==
[[File:Gloomwood_gameplay.png|right|thumb|Gameplay screenshot]]
''Gloomwood'' takes place from a [[First-person (video games)|first-person perspective]], with the player navigating the titular city. The player has the option to rely on either stealth or weapons, with stealth often being the most encouraged strategy.<ref name="BD-9-13-22">{{cite web|url=https://bloody-disgusting.com/video-games/3731700/gloomwood-early-access-proves-its-a-stealth-horror-classic-in-the-making/|title=''Gloomwood'' Early Access Proves It's a Stealth Horror Classic in the Making|last=Boehm|first=Aaron|date=September 13, 2022|work=[[Bloody Disgusting]]|access-date=July 8, 2023}}</ref> The player character is given a ring, which indicates the level of light in the environment and the amount of noise being generated. For instance, being exposed to light or walking on metal and rock surfaces increases the likelihood of alerting enemies. Conversely, remaining in darker, shadowy areas and moving on quieter surfaces are encouraged to avoid detection. With a stealth approach, the player can take down unsuspecting enemies from behind using a sword cane and eavesdrop to obtain information.<ref name=CBR-7-22-21/> Items like cans and bottles can also be thrown to distract enemies.<ref name="PCG-9-9-22">{{cite web|url=https://www.pcgamer.com/gloomwood-is-too-good-to-play-unfinished/|title=''Gloomwood'' is too good to play unfinished|last=Park|first=Morgan|date=September 9, 2022|work=[[PC Gamer]]|access-date=July 8, 2023}}</ref>

In addition to stealth, the player has the ability to fight with various types of weapons, including a sword cane,<ref name="GameRant-9-17-22">{{cite web|url=https://gamerant.com/beginner-tips-gloomwood/|title=5 Beginner Tips For ''Gloomwood''|last=Armstrong|first=Patrick|date=September 17, 2022|work=[[Game Rant]]|access-date=July 8, 2023}}</ref> different kinds of guns ([[revolver]]s and [[shotgun]]s<ref name="GameRant-1-29-23">{{cite web|url=https://gamerant.com/gloomwood-best-weapons-ranked/|title=''Gloomwood'': Best Weapons, Ranked|last=Marty|first=Emily Mei|date=January 29, 2023|work=[[Game Rant]]|access-date=July 8, 2023}}</ref>) with ammo for them occasionally scattered around the map, and explosive barrels that can be blown up upon being shot.<ref name="RPS-9-12-22">{{cite web|url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/gloomwoods-grimy-stealth-playground-deserves-better-than-the-agony-of-early-access|title=''Gloomwood''{{'s}} grimy stealth playground deserves better than the agony of early access|last=Bell|first=Alice|date=September 12, 2022|work=[[Rock Paper Shotgun]]|access-date=July 8, 2023}}</ref> The amount of ammo that can be found depends on the selected difficulty.<ref name="Waypoint-9-9-22">{{cite web|url=https://www.vice.com/en/article/gloomwood-is-more-than-just-a-spiritual-successor-to-thief/|title=''Gloomwood'' Is More Than Just a Spiritual Successor to ''Thief''|last=Price|first=Renata|date=September 9, 2022|work=Waypoint|publisher=[[Vice Media]]|access-date=July 8, 2023}}</ref> The weapons can also be opened to check how much ammo is in them. Traps and harpoon guns can also be obtained.<ref name=CBR-7-22-21/>

The player carries a briefcase, which uses a grid-based inventory system, that has a finite amount of space. The grid-based inventory system has drawn comparisons to ''[[Resident Evil 4]]''{{'s}} inventory system.<ref name="RPS-6-13-22">{{cite web|url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/thief-with-guns-stealth-em-up-gloomwood-shoots-into-early-access-in-august|title={{'}}''Thief'' with guns' stealth 'em up ''Gloomwood'' shoots into early access in August|last=Wheeler|first=CJ|date=June 13, 2022|work=[[Rock Paper Shotgun]]|access-date=July 8, 2023}}</ref><ref name="GameSpot-6-24-21">{{cite web|url=https://www.gamespot.com/articles/gloomwood-developer-is-tired-of-explaining-how-the-games-fancy-shotgun-works/1100-6493236/|title=''Gloomwood'' Developer Is Tired Of Explaining How The Game's Fancy Shotgun Works|last=Wright|first=Steven T.|date=June 24, 2021|work=[[GameSpot]]|access-date=July 10, 2023}}</ref> There are health items (such as syringes), coins, keys, and maps.<ref name=PCG-9-9-22/> Areas of the map contain gramophones (indicated from the music they play), which act as save points<ref name="Escapist-9-30-22" /> (similar to ''[[Resident Evil]]{{'s}}'' typewriter system<ref name="BD-9-13-22" />). The map also contains secret areas with extra pickups, and shortcuts that are unlocked via different keys.<ref name="BD-9-13-22" /> There are puzzles to complete within the map as well.<ref name="Eurogamer-9-7-22" />

==Release==
===Pre-release===
On June 16, 2020, the game was announced at the 2020 [[PC Gaming Show]] with a reveal trailer.<ref name="PCGN-6-14-20">{{cite web|url=https://www.pcgamesn.com/gloomwood/announcement|title=''Gloomwood'' is a ''Thief''-like survival horror from the makers of ''Dusk''|last=McGlynn|first=Anthony|date=June 14, 2020|work=[[PCGamesN]]|access-date=July 8, 2023}}</ref> In the trailer, [[Terri Brosius]] (who previously voiced Viktoria in the first two ''Thief'' games) voiced the Countess of Gloomwood. Over Twitter, Dillon Rogers confirmed her involvement.<ref name=PCG-9-14-22/> A [[Game demo|demo]] was released on the same day,<ref name=RPS-6-13-20/> and the early access release was given an initial release date of August 16, 2022.<ref name=RPS-6-13-22/>

In reference to its similarities with the ''[[Thief (series)|Thief]]'' series, the developers bought the [[Domain name|domain]] "ThiefWithGuns.com" for the game.<ref name=Verge-10-25-22/><ref name="Forbes-5-30-23">{{cite web |last=Nichiporchik |first=Alex |date=May 30, 2023 |title=Tips To Get Your Game Noticed By Publishers And Investors |url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/forbesbusinesscouncil/2023/05/30/tips-to-get-your-game-noticed-by-publishers-and-investors/?sh=42f64e6a4e00 |access-date=July 8, 2023 |work=[[Forbes]] |quote=Retro FPS (first-person shooter) publisher New Blood goes as far as registering humorous (but descriptive) [[URL]]s for their games, such as devilmayquake.com and thiefwithguns.com. This is sharp pitching taken to extremes and ideal for a business card.}}</ref> Prior to the early access release, Dillon Rogers teased at upcoming features for the game,<ref name="PCG-9-14-22" /> such as the inclusion for new weapons and destructible lighting.<ref name="NME-6-12-22">{{cite web|url=https://www.nme.com/news/gaming-news/stealth-horror-shooter-gloomwood-has-a-release-date-3245357|title=Stealth horror-shooter ''Gloomwood'' has a release date|last=Faulkner|first=Cheri|date=June 12, 2022|work=[[NME]]|access-date=July 8, 2023}}</ref> Early access was delayed and pushed to September 6, 2022 due to development and [[COVID-19]] related issues. As a compromise, the "Act 2" update for New Blood's ''[[Ultrakill]]'' was released.<ref name="BD-8-4-22">{{cite web|url=https://bloody-disgusting.com/video-games/3726004/gloomwood-bumped-to-september-release-ultrakill-update-moved-up-to-august-16th/|title=''Gloomwood'' Bumped to September Release, ''Ultrakill'' Update Moved up to August 16th|last=Wilson|first=Mike|date=August 4, 2022|work=[[Bloody Disgusting]]|access-date=July 8, 2023}}</ref><ref name="Destructoid-8-2-22">{{cite web|url=https://www.destructoid.com/gloomwood-ultrakill-delay-act-2-new-blood-interactive-news/|title=''Gloomwood'' Early Access has been delayed, and ''Ultrakill'' Act 2 is moving into its slot|last=Van Allen|first=Eric|date=August 2, 2022|work=[[Destructoid]]|access-date=July 11, 2023}}</ref> New Blood Interactive co-founder, Dave Oshry, uploaded a video to [[Twitter]] featuring [[Malcolm McDowell]] addressing the fans.<ref name="NME-8-3-22">{{cite web|url=https://www.nme.com/news/gaming-news/a-clockwork-oranges-malcolm-mcdowell-announces-gloomwood-delay-3282586|title=''A Clockwork Orange''{{'s}} Malcolm McDowell announces ''Gloomwood'' delay|last=Shutler|first=Ali|date=August 3, 2022|work=[[NME]]|access-date=July 8, 2023}}</ref> On September 5 (a day before), early access for the game released on [[Steam (service)|Steam]] for $20 USD.<ref name="RPS-9-6-22">{{cite web|url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/gloomwoods-thief-with-guns-em-up-sneaks-into-enters-early-access|title=''Gloomwood''{{'s}} ''Thief''-with-guns 'em up sneaks into enters early access|last=Smith|first=Graham|date=September 6, 2022|work=[[Rock Paper Shotgun]]|access-date=July 8, 2023}}</ref> New Blood Interactive co-founder, Dave Oshry, explained the release timing was done to avoid overlap with [[CD Projekt]]'s showcase of extra content for ''[[Cyberpunk 2077]]''. This resulted in ''Gloomwood'' becoming #1 on [[Steam (service)|Steam]]'s top 10 for 24 hours.<ref name="GR+-9-7-22">{{cite web|url=https://www.gamesradar.com/thief-with-guns-fps-gloomwood-tops-steam-after-shifting-launch-plans-to-dodge-cyberpunk-2077-showcase/|title={{'}}''Thief'' with guns' FPS ''Gloomwood'' tops Steam after shifting launch plans to dodge ''Cyberpunk 2077'' showcase|last=Wood|first=Austin|date=September 7, 2022|work=[[GamesRadar+]]|access-date=July 8, 2023}}</ref>

===Early access reception===
The early access release of ''Gloomwood'' has received positive reviews from critics and players<ref name=SR-9-9-22/> alike. By September 7, 2022, the game garnered an "overwhelmingly positive" score out of a thousand ratings on [[Steam (service)|Steam]].<ref name=GR+-9-7-22/>

Many critics heavily praised the level design,<ref name=PCG-9-9-22/><ref name=BD-9-13-22/><ref name=Paste-10-12-22>{{cite web|url=https://www.pastemagazine.com/games/gloomwood/gloomwood-early-access-preview|title=''Gloomwood'' Echoes the First-Person Stealth Horror Games of the Late '90s|last=Benfell|first=Grace|date=October 12, 2022|work=[[Paste (magazine)|Paste Magazine]]|access-date=July 8, 2023}}</ref> with Renata Price of ''[[Vice Media]]'' saying, "[It] isn't just good—it's exceptional",<ref name=Waypoint-9-9-22/> and Andrew King of ''[[TheGamer]]'' stating, "[The game] is a brilliant exercise in small scale level design against the backdrop of a larger world."<ref name="TheGamer-9-13-22">{{cite web|url=https://www.thegamer.com/gloomwood-early-access-review/|title='''Gloomwood'' Is Unbelievably Good (And Unfinished)|last=King|first=Andrew|date=September 13, 2022|work=TheGamer|access-date=July 8, 2023}}</ref> The atmosphere,<ref name="BD-9-13-22" /> world,<ref name="Paste-10-12-22" /> and gameplay mechanics<ref name="Kotaku-9-13-22" /> have also received praise. Aaron Boehm of ''[[Bloody Disgusting]]'' called it "a classic in the making."<ref name="BD-9-13-22" />

Andrei Pechalin of ''[[The Escapist (magazine)|The Escapist]]'' called ''Gloomwood'' "a masterclass" in its use of [[Cost–benefit analysis|cost–benefit scenarios]], where the player must weigh the benefits between using acquired gear against enemies or eschewing from doing so in order to avoid detection and/or to conserve the gear.<ref name="Escapist-9-30-22" /> The game has also been criticized for its unfinished elements. Alice Bell of ''[[Rock Paper Shotgun]]'' gave an overall positive review, calling it, "a grubby delight of a game", but criticized its unfinished nature. Because of this, Bell didn't recommend it on launch.<ref name="RPS-9-12-22" /> Morgan Park of ''[[PC Gamer]]'' drew similar conclusions, stating, "It's good as-is, but unless you're truly desperate for an immersive sim fix, you're better off waiting until it's all out, which is exactly what I intend to do now."<ref name="PCG-9-9-22" />

''Gloomwood'' was also the subject of an 18-minute documentary by [[Noclip]].<ref>{{cite AV media|date=January 12, 2023|title=How ''Gloomwood'' Combines Survival Horror & Immersive Sims|language=English|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BRsWvtJSm0U|access-date=July 8, 2023|publisher=[[Noclip]]}}</ref>
